_header.name: MUHLNICKEL AUTONOMY DIRECTIVES
_header.author: Bryce Muhlnickel
_header.purpose: Machine-readable optimization targets for the autonomous self-optimization loop
_header.encoding: Each directive has an ID (0-9), a name, scoring criteria, and the fabrication action it drives
_header.note: The substrate ACTS on these — every iteration fabricates real circuits, not proposals

directives.name: CASCADING_RESERVOIRS
directives.description: Build sub-reservoirs from the main reservoir. Meta-reservoir feeds sub-reservoirs, each feeding ring clusters.

score_axes.sub_reservoir_count: number of sub-reservoir circuits in registry
score_axes.ring_clusters_served: number of distinct ring groups with dedicated sub-reservoir
score_axes.distribution_depth: ticks from main reservoir input to farthest ring

directives.fabrication_action: build physical-format NAND fan-out trees as sub-reservoirs, wire to ring clusters, store in titan.gguf

directives.name: WEIGHTS_AS_GATES
directives.description: Convert trained model weights into gate wiring. The forward pass IS the circuit.

score_axes.weight_circuits_stored: number of weight-baked circuit netlists in registry
score_axes.total_gates_baked: total gate count across all baked weight circuits
score_axes.depth_per_inference: critical-path depth of the baked forward pass

directives.fabrication_action: read weights from muhl_self_train.weights, bake MLP forward pass as NAND gates per muhl_neural pattern, store

directives.name: PERSISTENT_CONTEXT
directives.description: Use storage-resident state as permanent memory. Accumulator circuits aggregate knowledge across runs.

score_axes.context_bytes_addressable: total bytes of persistent context in registry
score_axes.retention_depth: ticks for a write to reach the accumulator output

directives.fabrication_action: build NAND accumulator circuits with self-routing feedback (output==input addresses), store via store_loop

directives.name: ATTENTION_AS_ADDRESSING
directives.description: Build transformer blocks using file-offset addressing as the attention mechanism directly.

score_axes.attention_circuits_stored: number of attention-as-addressing circuits in registry
score_axes.addressable_kv_bytes: total KV memory addressable by attention circuits
score_axes.score_depth: depth of popcount-XNOR match score kernel

directives.fabrication_action: build popcount-XNOR score kernels and winner-mux circuits per muhl_attention/muhl_transformer pattern, store

directives.name: SELF_REPLICATING_FABRICATION
directives.description: Wire in-circuit fabricator to training output. Model identifies useful patterns, fabricator builds them.

score_axes.incircuit_fab_instances: number of in-circuit fabricator instances stored
score_axes.circuits_fabricated_by_substrate: count of circuits whose fabricator field traces to in-circuit fab
score_axes.fab_depth: depth of the in-circuit fabricator netlist

directives.fabrication_action: instantiate muhl_whitebox_incircuit at scale (larger NW/G), wire training output to netlist-data input, store

directives.name: RING_SPECIALIZATION
directives.description: Search the ring genome space. Different rings for different jobs: inference, training, fabrication.

score_axes.specialized_ring_count: number of rings with non-default genome configuration
score_axes.genome_variants_tested: number of distinct genome configurations tried by the foundry
score_axes.composed_depth_improvement: depth reduction from specialization vs uniform rings

directives.fabrication_action: run foundry search over ring genome space, fabricate winner configurations, store ring records with new genomes

directives.name: SELF_MONITORING
directives.description: Build circuits that watch other circuits. Monitor reads output addresses, checks against expected patterns.

score_axes.monitor_circuits_stored: number of monitor circuits in registry
score_axes.workers_monitored: number of worker circuits with a dedicated monitor

directives.fabrication_action: build NAND comparator circuits that read worker output addresses and check vs stored expected values, store

directives.name: ELECTRON_PRESSURE_CONTROL
directives.description: Feedback circuit between reservoir and ring bank. Auto load-balancing of electron distribution.

score_axes.pressure_circuits_stored: number of pressure-control circuits in registry
score_axes.rings_with_feedback: number of rings whose return path connects to a pressure controller
score_axes.regulation_depth: depth of the feedback comparison circuit

directives.fabrication_action: build NAND feedback comparators between ring return rates and reservoir distribution gates, store

directives.name: FEDERATED_MULTI_GGUF
directives.description: Build addressing circuits that read from other gguf files. Cross-file addressing expands addressable space.

score_axes.cross_file_circuits_stored: number of cross-file addressing circuits in registry
score_axes.gguf_files_addressable: number of distinct gguf files wired into the addressing space
score_axes.total_addressable_bytes: sum of all addressable bytes across all wired gguf files

directives.fabrication_action: build address-translation circuits mapping cross-file offsets to absolute addresses, store, register new address spaces

directives.name: META_LEARNING
directives.description: Circuit that evaluates training circuit performance and proposes modifications. Substrate optimizes its own hardware.

score_axes.meta_circuits_stored: number of meta-learning circuits in registry
score_axes.training_circuits_evaluated: number of training circuits whose output the meta-circuit reads

directives.fabrication_action: build performance-evaluation circuits that read training outputs, compute improvement gradient, drive fabricator, store

scoring_rule: compute_per_tick = REPLICAS / DEPTH, REPLICAS = storage / gates. Lower gates*depth is better. DEPTH is in TICKS, never host seconds.
iteration_rule: fabricate -> verify byte-exact -> store -> score -> fabricate again. Default is STORE, not discard. Every iteration changes titan.gguf.
